# VaultSync CLI generated command reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_cli_reference.py. Do not edit manually. -->

This reference is generated from the registered command tree. The practical handbook is
[CLI.md](CLI.md). Run `vaultsync COMMAND --help` against your installed version for
the authoritative options supported by that executable. The early
`vaultsync --version [--json]` shortcut is also supported.

## `vaultsync`

```text
╭─ VAULTSYNC CLI 1.9.0 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ Snapshot · Back up · Verify · Recover                                        │
│ Power-user tools for inspecting project history and running safe recovery    │
│ workflows.                                                                   │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
Docs:
https://github.com/ATAC-Helicopter/VaultSync/blob/release/1.9.0/docs/CLI.md
Website: https://fglabs.dev/vaultsync
Repository: https://github.com/ATAC-Helicopter/VaultSync
Releases: https://github.com/ATAC-Helicopter/VaultSync/releases/latest

Handbook: vaultsync docs

USAGE:
    vaultsync [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    projects                        Register, inspect, discover, and manage
                                    protected project sources
    snapshots                       Index source state and inspect local
                                    snapshot history; snapshots alone are not
                                    stored backups
    backups                         Create and inspect recorded backups; records
                                    alone do not prove payload availability
    recovery                        Recover recorded backup data through
                                    supported restore workflows
    mirror <name> <destination>     Mirror live project files with
                                    rsync/robocopy; does not create a recorded
                                    backup; supports --dry-run
    prune <name>                    Delete old snapshots by count (--keep-last)
                                    or date (--before). Supports --dry-run
    set-path <name> <newPath>       Update a project's root path
    update-path <name> <newPath>    Alias of set-path: update a project's root
                                    path
    restore <name> <destination>    Restore a recorded folder backup (latest by
                                    default) into a destination folder
    history <name>                  Show snapshot history for a project
    diff <name>                     Compare two snapshots (default: latest vs
                                    previous)
    self-test                       Run an end-to-end smoke test (temp project
                                    -> snapshot -> sync -> verify)
    init                            Initialize local config & database path
    add-project <name> <path>       Register a folder with a preset
    remove-project <name>           Unregister a project and remove its local
                                    history index; source and stored backup
                                    files remain
    list-projects                   List registered projects
    snapshot <name>                 Create a snapshot (scan + hash) of a project
    sync <name> <destination>       Mirror a project folder to a destination
                                    (rsync/robocopy)
    verify <name> <from>            Verify destination matches latest snapshot
                                    (sample or full)
    watch <ProjectName>             Watch a project for file changes and
                                    auto-snapshot/sync/verify
    doctor                          Check environment: rsync, DB path, project
                                    paths, and optional destination writability
    destinations                    List configured backup destinations and test
                                    their accessibility
    version                         Show version
    docs                            Show documentation links, print the bundled
                                    CLI handbook, or open it online
    completion <shell>              Print generated Bash, Zsh, or PowerShell
                                    completion (bash|zsh|powershell)
    config                          Inspect and modify VaultSync configuration
    presets                         View preset names and contents
```

## `vaultsync projects`

```text
DESCRIPTION:
Register, inspect, discover, and manage protected project sources

USAGE:
    vaultsync projects [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    add <name> <path>            Register an existing source folder with a
                                 preset
    list                         List projects with filters/limits; --output
                                 json provides versioned results
    show                         Inspect one project by literal name or explicit
                                 --id; supports --output json
    discover                     Discover candidate source folders beneath
                                 Projects Root; use --root to select a root
    set-path <name> <newPath>    Update a registered project's source folder
    remove <name>                Unregister a project and its local history
                                 index; source and backup files remain
```

## `vaultsync snapshots`

```text
DESCRIPTION:
Index source state and inspect local snapshot history; snapshots alone are not
stored backups

USAGE:
    vaultsync snapshots [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    create <name>     Scan and hash a project into the local index; does not
                      store backup bytes
    list <name>       List a project's indexed snapshots; --output json provides
                      versioned read-only results
    show <project>    Inspect one same-project snapshot, history markers, and
                      recorded backup references
    diff <name>       Compare two same-project snapshots; --output json provides
                      bounded versioned results
    prune <name>      Prune eligible local snapshot indexes; protected and
                      backed snapshots remain; supports --dry-run
```

## `vaultsync backups`

```text
DESCRIPTION:
Create and inspect recorded backups; records alone do not prove payload
availability

USAGE:
    vaultsync backups [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    create <project>    Create a full folder backup at an explicit destination;
                        supports --dry-run
    list <project>      List a project's recorded backups with stable local IDs
                        and optional versioned JSON
    show <project>      Inspect one project-scoped backup record without
                        exposing storage paths or secrets
    verify <project>    Hash-check recorded folder-backup bytes against the
                        selected snapshot
```
